note: Read-only across departments. Breach codes come from server/lib/circuitBreaker.ts.

breach_codes.TOKEN_VELOCITY: Tokens per minute over the ceiling.
breach_codes.CALL_RATE: Requests per minute over the ceiling.
breach_codes.LOOP_DETECTED: Identical payload repeated — agent is looping.
breach_codes.UNAUTHORIZED_MCP: Agent reached for an MCP server outside its scope.
breach_codes.SCOPE_VIOLATION: Agent invoked a tool outside its department whitelist.
breach_codes.UNGROUNDED_CLAIM: Output asserted a fact absent from retrieved context.
